name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three installments
summary: Income support for qualifying landholding farmer families, subject to exclusions and government verification.

rules.label: No PM-KISAN exclusion applies to the family

limitations: Self-reported land and exclusions cannot establish official eligibility. Government land records, family definition, date of land acquisition, state exceptions and registration must be checked with the official portal.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
benefit: Central contribution: ₹200 monthly ages 60–79, ₹500 monthly from age 80; state top-ups vary
summary: NSAP old-age pension for a person aged 60 or over in a BPL household.

rules.label: Household is BPL under the official list/criteria

limitations: Income amount by itself does not prove BPL status. Government/local authority must verify BPL record and application.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
benefit: Central contribution: ₹300 monthly (state additions may vary)
summary: NSAP pension for BPL widows aged 40–59.

rules.label: Household is BPL under official criteria

limitations: Government/local authority must verify widow and BPL status; this tool cannot determine official entitlement.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
benefit: Central contribution: ₹300 monthly (state additions may vary)
summary: NSAP pension for BPL people aged 18–59 with severe or multiple disabilities.

rules.label: Household is BPL under official criteria

limitations: Government/local authority must verify disability classification and BPL status; this tool cannot determine official entitlement.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
benefit: ₹2 lakh life cover on death from any cause; annual premium applies
summary: Renewable one-year life insurance for participating bank or post-office account holders enrolling at ages 18–50.
limitations: This age comparison alone cannot establish eligibility or coverage. A participating bank/post-office account, consent to auto-debit, premium, enrolment period, exclusions and current terms need verification. The official page listed an annual premium of ₹436 when checked in September 2026; verify before joining.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
benefit: Accident cover up to ₹2 lakh for death or specified permanent disability; annual premium applies
summary: Renewable one-year accident insurance for participating bank or post-office account holders aged 18–70.
limitations: Age alone cannot establish enrolment or coverage. A participating bank/post-office account, consent to auto-debit, sufficient balance, accident definition and current terms must be verified. The official page listed a ₹20 annual premium when checked in September 2026; verify before joining.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
benefit: Contribution-based guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 from age 60, depending on contribution
summary: Contributory pension option for citizens enrolling at ages 18–40 with a savings account; income-tax payer exclusion applies to new enrolment.
limitations: Age alone cannot establish eligibility. Savings account, nationality, contribution choice and tax-payer exclusion for joiners since October 2022 must be verified with the official source. This is not a welfare payout without contributions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
benefit: Contributory pension of ₹3,000 monthly after age 60
summary: A voluntary pension for eligible small and marginal landholding farmers who join at ages 18–40. Contributions and exclusions apply.
limitations: Owning land alone does not prove small/marginal farmer status. Monthly contributions, land records and exclusions need official checks.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefit: Crop insurance; cover, premium and claim depend on notified crop and area
summary: Crop insurance for farmers, including sharecroppers or tenants, growing notified crops in notified areas.
limitations: A crop, location and season must be notified. This guide cannot verify enrolment, premium or claim.

name: PM-KUSUM
benefit: Solar pumps and farm-energy support; component terms vary
summary: Farm energy programme with solar pump and decentralised power components. Which components are open varies by state and tender.
limitations: Not every applicant can join every component; check the state implementing agency and current notices.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefit: Bank credit for farming needs; a loan, not a grant
summary: A bank credit facility for qualifying agricultural and allied activities.
limitations: A repayable bank credit facility, not a grant. RBI revised directions issued 19 June 2026 take effect only for loans sanctioned from 1 January 2027. For a current application, ask the bank for its presently applicable KCC terms and eligibility.

name: Disha early-intervention centres
benefit: Early intervention and day-care services, not cash to the family
summary: National Trust centres for children aged 0–10 with disabilities covered by the National Trust Act.
limitations: Centre access, disability classification and enrollment must be checked with a registered provider.

name: Vikaas day-care and skills centres
benefit: Day-care and vocational services, not a direct grant
summary: National Trust centre services for persons aged 10 or older with disabilities covered by the National Trust Act.
limitations: Availability depends on a registered centre; assessment and simultaneous-enrolment restrictions apply.

name: Niramaya disability health insurance
benefit: Health insurance cover up to ₹1 lakh, subject to terms
summary: Health insurance for persons with disabilities covered by the National Trust Act and valid disability documentation.
limitations: Specific disability category, certificate/UDID status, premium and insurer terms must be checked.

name: ADIP aids and assistive devices
benefit: Assistive devices through approved implementing agencies
summary: Aid for eligible persons with disabilities to obtain assistive devices.
limitations: Disability, income, device need and local implementation require checks; not a general cash grant.

name: Livestock Insurance under National Livestock Mission
benefit: Insurance for eligible livestock; premium and cover vary
summary: Government-backed livestock insurance delivered through the relevant animal-husbandry scheme/platform.
limitations: Species, animal identification, local rollout, insurer and premium must be checked.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
benefit: Contributory pension after age 60
summary: Voluntary old-age pension for eligible unorganised workers who join at ages 18–40.
limitations: Income, occupation, exclusions and monthly contributions need checks; not an unconditional pension.

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana (PM-JAY age 70+)
benefit: Up to ₹5 lakh healthcare coverage under PM-JAY rules
summary: PM-JAY health coverage for Indian citizens aged 70 or above regardless of income, with a separate senior card.
limitations: Age and citizenship must be established by the official process. Hospital, card and treatment rules apply; not a cash payout.

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY)
benefit: Assisted-living devices for eligible age-related infirmities
summary: A component of Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana supporting eligible older people with age-related disability or infirmity.
limitations: This is a component under AVYAY, not a separate general pension. Income, infirmity and camp availability need official checks.

name: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
benefit: Interest on a funded savings account; rates change
summary: A government-backed savings account for eligible senior citizens, not a welfare grant.
limitations: The usual entry age is 60, with specific exceptions for some retirees. Check age, retirement proof, deposit, rate and withdrawal terms officially; this is not a grant.

name: National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly (NPHCE)
benefit: Geriatric health services where facilities participate
summary: Health-care programme providing geriatric services through participating public facilities.
limitations: Local service availability must be checked. This is not direct cash assistance.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
benefit: Maternity benefit; amount and instalments depend on current rules
summary: Maternity benefit for qualifying pregnancies, including the current second-child girl-child provision.
limitations: Pregnancy, birth order, employment exclusions and records are not known from a basic profile.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
benefit: LPG connection support for qualifying poor households
summary: New LPG connection for an adult woman from a qualifying poor household with no other household LPG connection.
limitations: Income or BPL answer alone does not establish the required deprivation declaration or absence of an LPG connection.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Account
benefit: Interest-bearing savings account for a girl child, not a grant
summary: Guardian-opened savings account for an eligible girl child under age 10.
limitations: Account is for a girl child, not any adult woman; guardian, age and deposits are not captured in this profile.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
benefit: Conditional support for eligible institutional delivery
summary: A safe-motherhood programme supporting qualifying institutional deliveries under NHM.
limitations: State category, pregnancy, facility and local criteria determine any benefit.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
benefit: Scholarship for eligible school students
summary: Means-cum-merit support subject to class, family income, school type and selection test.
limitations: School, grade, income, test result and application window are not known from this profile.

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College and University Students
benefit: Higher-education scholarship subject to marks and income
summary: Scholarship for eligible students entering undergraduate or postgraduate study.
limitations: Board percentile, course, income, other scholarships and application window need checks.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
benefit: Post-matric educational support under scheme and state rules
summary: Scholarship for eligible Scheduled Caste students pursuing qualifying post-matric study.
limitations: Caste certificate, course, family income and state administration require verification.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
benefit: Scholarship for eligible technical education
summary: Support for girl students in qualifying AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma courses.
limitations: Course approval, family income, selection and current application window need checks.

name: Scholarships for Students with Disabilities
benefit: Educational support under the applicable scholarship component
summary: DEPwD umbrella scheme with distinct pre-matric, post-matric and higher-education components.
limitations: The correct component depends on education level, disability certificate, income and current application period.

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefit: Training, toolkit support and concessional credit by stage
summary: Support for eligible self-employed artisans in listed traditional trades.
limitations: The trade, family restriction, existing loans and verification are not captured. Credit is repayable.

name: PM SVANidhi
benefit: Working-capital loan for eligible street vendors, not a grant
summary: Micro-credit facility for qualifying street vendors with local identification and lending checks.
limitations: Vendor status, local certificate, lender and current loan terms require verification.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
benefit: Hospital treatment cover for eligible beneficiaries under programme rules
summary: Cashless hospitalisation programme for identified households, distinct from general health insurance purchase.
limitations: Income or occupation alone cannot establish beneficiary-list inclusion; check the official beneficiary portal.

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
benefit: Free public-facility maternal and child services under programme rules
summary: NHM programme addressing costs of eligible maternal and child care in public health facilities.
limitations: Availability and covered service must be checked locally. This is a service, not cash.

name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK 2.0)
benefit: Child health screening and referral where available
summary: NHM child screening and early-intervention service programme.
limitations: Age, referral, facility and local implementation are not captured; not a cash grant.

name: Rashtriya Kishor Swasthya Karyakram (RKSK)
benefit: Adolescent health counselling and services where available
summary: NHM programme for adolescent health services and outreach.
limitations: Local service access must be checked. Not a cash grant.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G)
benefit: Rural housing assistance under approved beneficiary lists
summary: Rural housing programme prioritising eligible households identified through the official process.
limitations: Income or housing description alone cannot establish beneficiary-list status. Local verification required.

name: PMAY-U 2.0: Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC)
benefit: Urban housing construction assistance under BLC rules
summary: One of four PMAY-U 2.0 verticals for eligible families building their own house.
limitations: Component of one programme, not a separate independent scheme. Urban, ownership and household conditions must be verified.

name: PMAY-U 2.0: Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP)
benefit: Eligible urban housing through approved partnership projects
summary: One of four PMAY-U 2.0 verticals for qualifying households and projects.
limitations: Component of one programme, not an independent scheme. Project and beneficiary selection must be checked.

name: PMAY-U 2.0: Affordable Rental Housing (ARH)
benefit: Affordable rental housing in available approved projects
summary: One of four PMAY-U 2.0 verticals for EWS/LIG urban groups including workers and migrants.
limitations: Component of one programme, not ownership aid or free housing. Rent, units and local availability vary.

name: PMAY-U 2.0: Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS)
benefit: Home-loan interest subsidy under current limits
summary: One of four PMAY-U 2.0 verticals for qualifying home-loan borrowers.
limitations: Component of one programme, not a grant for every applicant. Income, loan and property conditions need verification.
